name: typefix-20261111-reload-dev
description: Typefix 20261111, step 2 of 2: puts back the decimals numeric(18,4) cut on opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table, from the legacy values staged by typefix-20261111-stage-mysql-dev.json. One step per column. A value is changed ONLY when it is exactly the legacy value cut to 4 decimals (round(legacy, 4) = current) and the legacy value has more decimals, so values changed in the new system after the migration are left alone. targetAfter 0 = no value left that is still the cut. Before step 1, create the staging table once (DBeaver): CREATE TABLE opera.typefix_20261111_src (business_unit text NOT NULL, trade_id text NOT NULL, original_lots double precision, premium double precision, spcl_rate double precision, active_lots double precision, netted_lots double precision, lots_to_be_netted double precision, loaded_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (business_unit, trade_id)). Steps 7-12 cover the records MySQL does not have (created in the new system after the migration, newer versions): deal_ticket_table premium, original_lots, spcl_rate, lots_to_be_netted, broker_lots were always double precision, so the same trade and version there still holds the full value (one distinct value required); active_lots comes from latest_active_lot (double). Same guard: only a clone value that is exactly that value cut to 4 decimals is changed. netted_lots exists only on the clone: new records cannot be restored for it. Afterwards: refresh the client statement cache (and cash balance / RRR runs to compare).

steps.where: tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND original_lots IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.typefix_20261111_src s WHERE s.business_unit = cloned_deal_ticket_table.business_unit AND s.trade_id = cloned_deal_ticket_table.trade_id AND s.original_lots IS NOT NULL AND s.original_lots <> cloned_deal_ticket_table.original_lots AND round(s.original_lots::numeric, 4)::double precision = cloned_deal_ticket_table.original_lots)

set.original_lots: (SELECT s.original_lots FROM opera.typefix_20261111_src s WHERE s.business_unit = cloned_deal_ticket_table.business_unit AND s.trade_id = cloned_deal_ticket_table.trade_id)

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table'::regclass AND attname = 'premium' AND NOT attisdropped AND atttypid = 'float8'::regtype
